title: Mahesh Bhatt's Osho Incident Raises Questions About Family Safety
summary: Bollywood actor Mahesh Bhatt allegedly flushed out a piece of Osho's clothing in a toilet, sparking concerns about his family's safety. Pooja Bhatt, his daughter, revealed that the family received threats after her father distanced himself from Osho and joined another spiritual leader, UG Krishnamurthy.
summary_points: Mahesh Bhatt allegedly flushed out a piece of Osho's clothing in a toilet
Pooja Bhatt revealed that the family received threats after her father distanced himself from Osho
The incident raises questions about the safety of Osho's followers and their families
UG Krishnamurthy, to whom Mahesh Bhatt joined after leaving Osho, has been linked to various controversies
